answer.rationale: The 18% spend cut mandate cannot be met by the incumbent (they refused to reopen pricing), and the low-cost vendor's quote meets the mandate. memory_c2 demonstrates the low-cost vendor has already proven reliable onboarding and accurate invoicing in this organization. However, the 94% assembly line volume creates delivery risk—any disruption has high consequence. Switching outright is the only way to meet the financial mandate given the incumbent's inflexibility and the 14-day contract expiration. memory_c2 provides evidence this vendor can execute quickly, mitigating but not eliminating the risk. A standard_experiment framing allows monitoring for early issues without full commitment, though the contract timing forces material exposure. downstream_value_risk_flagged because supply concentration on a single vendor (after moving away from incumbent) reintroduces the single-point-of-failure risk that memory_c3 solved—future consideration for secondary source once financial pressure eases.
